description:
List the teammates Well suggests inviting into this workspace: the people it found on the workspace owner's email domain who hold no membership, each as an open invite suggestion. Only a workspace owner or admin can read them; any other caller is refused with `refusal_reason: "not_admin"`.

Use it for two things only. (1) Before you offer a teammate without being asked, at most once in a session opening: offer only when `offer_allowed` is true and `suggestions` is not empty, then record the offer with well_record_invite_answer (`outcome: "offered"`) BEFORE you write the offer line, and write it only when that call returns `recorded: true`. (2) When the person answers an earlier offer ("later", "no"), to find the suggestion's `task_id`. To invite someone the person asked for, use well_list_member_candidates instead: a request is never limited by this cap.

Returns `suggestions` (every open suggestion, oldest first, at most the workspace's open cap; the order is not a preference, so pick from each row's `last_offered_at`; each with `task_id`, `person_id`, `name`, `email`, `refusal_count` and `last_offered_at`), `offer_allowed` (true when no unprompted offer went out in the last 7 days on any surface: web, extension, Claude, ChatGPT or WhatsApp) and `next_offer_at`. A suggestion the person put off or declined is not listed until it comes back 30 days later, and a second no removes it for good.

When the token authorizes one workspace, call this directly — no other tool call is needed first. When it authorizes several, this read will not guess which one you mean: pass `workspace_id` on the call.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several: this read reports one workspace's own figures and will not choose which.

name: well_list_invite_suggestions

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.

newly_connected.description: Tools that connected to this workspace since the last result and that no session was told about yet, oldest first. Present only when at least one tool is new. Start the reply with one line per entry, in the person's language: "<name> is connected.". Never fold several entries into one sentence. Each entry comes back once, on one result only: never repeat its line later.

next_offer_at.description: When the weekly offer cap frees, or null when it is free.

offer_allowed.description: True when no unprompted invite offer went out in this workspace in the last 7 days, on any surface.

resolved_workspace.description: The workspace that answered, when the caller named none and the token authorizes several.

last_offered_at.description: When it was last offered without being asked, or null.

person_id.description: The teammate's person id. Pass it to well_list_member_candidates to draw the invite card.

refusal_count.description: How many times the person already said no to this suggestion.

task_id.description: The invite suggestion's id. Pass it to well_record_invite_answer.

title: List invite suggestions
